english.title: Fail to enter certificate of release to service in technical log / approved record as required
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), following the rectification of a defect which had been entered in a technical log or approved record, having issued a certificate of release to service issued

(A)_[under the Air Navigation Order 2016,]_
(B)_[in respect of that defect,]_

failed to enter the certificate in the technical log or approved record in such a position as to be readily identifiable with the defect to which it related
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 227(7) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
following the rectification of a defect which had been entered in a technical log or approved record
having issued a certificate of release to service issued under the Air Navigation Order 2016 or in respect of that defect
failed to enter the certificate in the technical log or approved record in such a position as to be readily identifiable with the defect to which it related
